item.title: The one-person creative team, and the bill behind the pitch
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: attention is finite, so capturing it is a real craft and a real trade. What sells is the work of deciding who someone is, not thirty posts a day. On a November evening I read a long letter. The man who wrote it runs a content company of his own, and the subject was how to capture attention on social platforms.
